en.text: Tom knows the city like the back of his hand.

original: 何事もベストを尽くしなさい。

en.text: In doing anything, do your best.

original: 最善を尽くします。

en.text: I will do everything I can to help.
I'll do everything I can to help.

original: 火は村中を焼き尽くした。

en.text: The fire burned down the whole village.

original: 手は尽くしました。

en.text: I've done all I can.
I've done everything I can.
I have done all that I can.
I've done all that I can.
We did everything we could.
I did everything I could.

original: メアリーの部屋の壁は、ポスターで埋め尽くされていた。

en.text: The walls of Mary's room were covered with posters.

original: トムは食べ尽くした。

en.text: Tom ate everything.
